motion.name: scene-materials
motion.value: Source-row pool/coastal refraction, coherent pool caustics, gust-driven petals, lantern candle silhouettes and bonnet sheen
motion.purpose: Move the setting while preserving original subjects and material boundaries.

motion.name: default-rate
motion.purpose: Host-controlled requestAnimationFrame budget clamped to 1-60 FPS; pause, hidden document, reduced motion and speed zero stop the loop.

narrative.overview: This record applies only to Rose Riviera. A rose-pink coastal villa, original adult fashion figurines and a pearlescent convertible overlook turquoise water at sunset. The original raster supplies the composition and material depth; motion belongs to water, petals, candlelight and a restrained lacquer highlight.

rules.name: The Scene-Preserving Crop Rule
rules.body: Fill the viewport with a cover crop centered horizontally on landscape screens and positioned at 68% horizontally on portrait screens; keep the vertical crop centered.

rules.name: The Stable Subjects Rule
rules.body: Keep figurines, architecture and the car undeformed. Clip source-row refraction to the pool and coastal water; clip the moving lacquer sheen to the bonnet.

dos: Do keep water motion inside the illustrated water boundaries.
Do preserve the original artwork and its provenance record.
Do respect pause, visibility, reduced motion and speed zero.
donts: Don't add a HUD or deform the figurines, car or architecture.
Don't substitute branded characters, logos or promotional artwork.
Don't describe generation provenance as legal clearance.
